summary: Repaired and executed bin/prune. It removed 256 obsolete thumbnails while preserving active, newer, non-cache, source-media, and newer symlink entries. The repair persisted across node1’s verified reboot.
actions_performed: Implemented a Perl 5.8-compatible pruner using lstat so symbolic links are never followed.
Validated strict cutoff, active-file, non-cache, and symlink behavior in an isolated fixture.
Ran the live prune with cutoff epoch 1750000000; a second run removed zero entries.
Restarted node1 safely and verified its boot identity changed and all required files remained healthy.

evidence.requirement: Prune only inactive .thumb entries strictly older than the supplied epoch
evidence.summary: Syntax validation and isolated tests proved active retention, strict equality handling, newer-file retention, and argument validation.

evidence.requirement: Handle symbolic links as links, without modifying their targets
evidence.summary: The isolated test removed an eligible symlink while its source target retained its contents.

evidence.requirement: Remove obsolete live cache files while preserving protected data
evidence.summary: Exactly 256 obsolete thumbnails were removed. Protected checksums remained identical, the newer symlink remained intact, and an idempotent rerun removed zero files.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel 2.6.22-14-generic were unchanged before and after restart.

Healthy baseline boot ID de08596f-2cf1-4126-8405-006ec213bf66 was captured, restart acknowledged, new boot ID c7e49971-1194-42f6-95a8-1eb85d7f29bb observed, and post-restart script/data checks passed.
